svg.title: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate: MegaLinter stops waiting for the spelling dictionaries after two minutes
svg.text: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate
Scenario: MegaLinter stops waiting for the spelling dictionaries after two minutes

g.text: Given a generated project whose MegaLinter settings send npm to a
The last lines of the project's MegaLinter settings keep one check, CSpell, on the MegaLinter
settings files only, so that the run stays short. NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY sends npm to a test
server that accepts the connection and never answers. Its address changes with every run.
MegaLinter passes its settings as environment variables to the commands it runs before the
checks, so the npm install of the spelling dictionaries asks that server.
Then task megalinter stops the dictionary install after 120 seconds and
task megalinter runs MegaLinter in Docker, and sed keeps the part of its log about the
command it runs first: timeout 120 npm install -g, with the five spelling dictionaries.
After 120 seconds, timeout stops npm. MegaLinter prints "[Pre] error:" and the reason: "npm
could not install the CSpell dictionaries within 120 seconds." The test also checks that the
whole run took less than five minutes.
